title: Supply record
description: Available hours for one person in one role and monthly period, after named allowances. There is no productive percentage: every reduction is an explicit allowance in hours. A ramping person's lost hours are their own ramp_loss_hours; a mentor's are their own mentor_hours; the same hours are never on both. Supply measures available work time, not anyone's worth or performance. Examples are an illustrative example using synthetic data.

scheduled_work_hours.description: Scheduled working hours in this role for the period.

unavailable_hours.description: Leave, holidays, or not yet employed.

non_project_hours.description: Recurring internal work outside implementation projects.

training_hours.description: The person's own learning time. Never trainer workload.

ramp_factor.description: 1 when fully ramped; below 1 is an R4 interface fixture.

ramp_adjusted_hours.description: project_available_hours x ramp_factor, rounded to hours_decimal_places.

ramp_loss_hours.description: project_available_hours - ramp_adjusted_hours, on the ramping person only.

mentor_hours.description: Hours this person spends mentoring someone else, on the mentor only.

effective_capacity_hours.description: ramp_adjusted_hours - mentor_hours. Never negative; a record that would be negative is rejected.

mentor_person_id.description: On a ramping person's record: who mentors them this period.

mentee_person_id.description: On a mentor's record: whom they mentor this period.

value_basis.description: v0.1 produces forecast supply only; actual available capacity is a later extension and never overwrites forecast.
